**Finding: Deviation (medium) — no express performance/conformance warranty or remedy.**

What I found:
- **§5 warranties are all "rights and compliance" type only**: 5(a) compliance with law (and only "to its knowledge"), 5(b) authority/rights, 5(c) non-infringement, 5(d) anti-bribery. Nothing warrants that the Services or Works will actually work or conform to the Specifications.
- **No warranty period and no remedy** anywhere — no repair, replacement, re-performance or refund.
- **§1(b)** has a workmanlike-manner covenant, but it is a bare performance obligation with no warranty framing or remedy attached.
- **§4 is titled "ACCEPTANCE"** but contains no acceptance or rejection mechanics, so there is no alternative route to a conformance remedy.
- **§5(e) disclaims implied warranties** ("in lieu of all other warranties, express or implied") — it does not swallow express warranties, but with no conformance warranty present the net effect approaches the walk-away "AS IS" position.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`) inserts a new §5(f): conformance warranty of 12 months for software deliverables / 90 days for Services, a no-malicious-code warranty, an at-Contractor's-option re-perform/repair/replace remedy with refund if not cured in 30 days, and an express confirmation that 5(e) does not cut back the express warranties. Fallback of 90/30 days offered in the comment.
